notes: v209: iPad crash fixes. The glow around the selected country made Safari use more and more memory the further you zoomed in, until the iPad restarted the game: on iPhone and iPad the selected country now gets a bold white outline instead. The map's name layer uses less memory on Apple devices. And if a device ever runs out of memory while loading the HD voices, the next launch skips them (with a note) instead of crashing again.
